item.text: {"classifications":[{"segment_id":"1","code":2,"rationale":"The President directs the Secretary of Commerce to review and revise export policy and, pending that review, mandates a specified later agency licensing outcome: approval of validated export licenses must be withheld.","evidence":"Pending review, no validated export licenses for shipment of goods or technical data to the Soviet Union are to be approved."},{"segment_id":"2","code":1,"rationale":"The President directs the Secretary of Commerce to review existing licensed transactions, but leaves any later suspension or revocation to the Secretary's determination rather than dictating that legal outcome.","evidence":"determine whether any such licenses should be suspended or revoked"},{"segment_id":"3","code":1,"rationale":"The President directs an interagency determination about whether transactions should face validated-license requirements, without requiring that those requirements ultimately be imposed.","evidence":"determine whether certain transactions now under general license requirements should be subject to validated license requirements"}]}
